name: Abrahamson (2005) all-site plane-wave coherency (surface foundations)
applicability: All site conditions except severe topography, all magnitudes and distances (EPRI 1012968 Chapter 4); derived for frequencies up to 20 Hz (extrapolation to higher frequencies considered reasonable by the author); residuals checked for separations of 0-150 m. The 2007 EPRI validation studies (EPRI TR-1015111) used this isotropic model (ACS SASSI manual, Section 6.5.4).
equation: gamma_pw(f, xi) = [1 + (f tanh(a3 xi) / (a1 fc(xi)))^n1]^(-1/2) * [1 + (f tanh(a3 xi) / (a2 fc(xi)))^n2(xi)]^(-1/2)

source.primary: N. A. Abrahamson (2005/2006). Program on Technology Innovation: Spatial Coherency Models for Soil-Structure Interaction. EPRI 1012968, Electric Power Research Institute, Palo Alto, CA, and U.S. DOE; Technical Update, January 2006 (NRC ADAMS ML060400268 and ML090160186). Cited by the ACS SASSI manual as reference 2 (Abrahamson 2005, EPRI 1012968, December).
source.tables: Table 3-4 'Plane-Wave Coherency Model Coefficients for the Horizontal Component' and Table 3-5 '... for the Vertical Component', report page 3-6. The slowness s = 0.0005 to 0.00025 s/m of the tables belongs to the unlagged form (Equation 3-2) and is not used: SASSI-EDU applies wave passage through WPASS (Line D).
source.also: The same equation and coefficients are the 'Initial Coherency Model' of EPRI 1015110 (December 2007, ADAMS ML090960409), Equation 5-2 (page 5-8) and Tables 5-2 and 5-3 (page 5-9), plotted in Figure 5-4.
